journey.name: Lift: a rest heard with the screen off
journey.description: A rest between sets keeps counting on the lock screen and beeps as it ends while the screen is off, and so does a second rest started over the first, the phone held awake to its end and let go after. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), with the emulator's volume up.

actions.action: Tap "Log set" and verify that a rest counts down from "1:30" with − and + beside it
Verify that the system asks to allow notifications (Android 13+, the first rest only), and tap "Allow"
Tap "−" four times and verify that the rest reads "0:30" or less
Press Home and verify that the status bar shows a chip with the rest's time left (Android 16+)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that the "Resting" notification has PROMOTED_ONGOING among its flags and an android.progress below its android.progressMax
Return to the app (the launcher icon) and verify that the rest is still counting
Turn the screen off (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that an ongoing notification titled "Resting" with "left" in its text is showing
Wait for the rest to end and verify that the beeps 3-2-1 and Start played with the screen off (the emulator's audio, or logcat's AudioTrack lines)
Turn the screen on (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP) and swipe to unlock
Verify that the "Resting" notification is gone and the session shows "Next set"
Tap "Log set" and, while that rest counts, tap "Log set" again, and verify that a rest counts down afresh from "0:30" or less
Turn the screen off (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys power that a PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK tagged "interval:timer" is held
Wait for the rest to end and verify that the beeps 3-2-1 and Start played with the screen off
Wait ten seconds and verify with adb shell dumpsys power that no wake lock tagged "interval:timer" is held
Turn the screen on (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP) and swipe to unlock
